description: Ask FreightFA's AI freight analyst a question in plain language: lane rates, mode choice, capacity, fuel, carrier vetting, market news, or drafting an RFP. Answers cite their sources and can include a priced rate card. Pass session_id from a previous answer to continue the same conversation. Each question counts toward the account's monthly FreightFA allowance.

session_id.description: session_id returned by an earlier answer to continue that conversation, or null to start a new one.
